Definition: from G3624 and G1203; the head of a family:--goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.
BiblicalUsage: Oikodespotes is the master of the house, the householder, the goodman. Jesus is called the master of the house in Matthew 10:25, the householder whose field was sown with good seed in Matthew 13:27, and the goodman of the house in Mark 14:14 and Luke 12:39, the one who must watch for the thief.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the householder is the picture of the Lord of the house, and the parables keep asking the same question: will the master find his servants watching? My position is that the goodman who watches is the disciple, and the thief who comes is the hour no one knows.
RelatedTopics: Kingdom of God; Waiting on God
